fieldData.acrm---key-feature-2-content:
Follow-up questions where they apply

A tenant who says they have a dog is asked its breed and weight. One who parks on site gives a plate number for the permit. Everyone else never sees those two questions.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-1-des: Write down what stays the same for every tenant at this property, from the rent figure to who fixes a leaking tap. These become fixed text in the agreement, and no tenant can edit them when they fill in the form.
